messages:
Maya: Nightly eval (long-context prompt set) flagged a regression for rwd-7b-quant-v2 — lots of responses are abruptly truncated around ~32k tokens and the final instruction clause is often missing. Delta vs baseline is big (instruction-compliance +5.8%). Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artefacts/1763504200. Anyone touched KV/cache slicing or seq-splitting logic recently?
qa-bot: nightly-eval v3 completed — regression detected. metric: instruction_compliance delta=+0.058, failing_samples 42 -> 268.
Sam: I rolled a kernel selection tweak for quant paths yesterday (selective-fused-attn toggle). I didn't expect it to touch KV offsets but that's the only infra change I remember.
Devin: I can repro locally: `eval_harness --prompt-set long_instructions --model rwd-7b-quant-v2 --max-tokens 35000`. Logs show repeated warnings: `kv_cache_evicted layer=10 step=4096` then truncation.
Alejandra: Posting a representative failing example:
```
PROMPT: [system] You are an assistant. Follow steps A->B->C. Conversation history: <40k tokens of prior turns>
USER: Now do step C and then summarize.

OUTPUT: ...the model returns text and then simply stops mid-sentence, no summary, no follow-up.
```
The output drops the final instruction.
Tom: We did change chunking offset calc in infra last week (split_at_token_boundary). Could be an off-by-one when computing kv indices. @Sam can you revert the selective-fused-attn flag on a canary node?
Sam: Will roll revert to canary pool (rwd-7b-quant-v2-canary1) now and add extra kv debug prints.
infra-bot: deploy started: job_id=abc123, targets=[canary1,canary2], step=rollback-selective-fused-attn
Devin: Quick trace notes: raw kv offsets in layer dumps look consistent, but decoder loop logs show spikes in `kv_read_miss` counts exactly where truncation happens. Might be mapping error in quantized block index -> absolute token index.
Alejandra: Also reproducible when prompt has many code fences — tokenization spikes > expected, hits chunk-splitting path which uses different key-offset logic. That path might not be covered by unit tests.
Maya: Proposed triage plan: 1) confirm canary revert fixes nightly 2) add per-layer kv index debug logs to canary 3) re-run eval harness across quantized/fp16/float variants 4) add failing prompts into regression suite. Assign: Sam=revert+logs, Devin=trace analysis, Alejandra=add golden prompts.
Sam: Assigned. Revert done on canary1, pushing logs; will post results in ~20m.
qa-bot: noted — add failing_prompt_ids to regression set: ["lf_1032","lf_1089","lf_1101"].
Tom: If revert fixes it we'll do hotfix. If not, next step is run with `-kv-index-check` to diff offsets per layer and compare with pre-change baseline.
Maya: Thanks all — leaving this thread pinned for updates. Please paste any short reproductions here rather than creating new threads.
